data.prompt:
DocFit bounded post-unit semantic batch. Load the docfit-school-extract Skill and call docfit_evidence with focus=unit_evidence_packet and unit_id=unit-cover. This is batch 1 of 15 for accepted unit '封面'. Each entry includes all unit_contexts it crosses, with exact text per unit. Judge each assigned entry once over its complete text. Ordered parts must end at each unit-context text boundary, even when adjacent roles are identical. The unit packet remains the readable context, but this candidate owns exactly the following source entries in this exact order:
["source-entry-2eb746e9f08a1ba6d753dcf9", "source-entry-a79ebe4d35f00ce60425c8fb", "source-entry-9b2d25e2ec28a655fd44e544", "source-entry-10cfd98db3c56bc0e57d4045", "source-entry-8b5e13175bbd973284180ce1", "source-entry-937c6030b089a6b34dde55a4", "source-entry-f3ac4bef4cb2115a98e2e353", "source-entry-8ed59c3df37967d503e83103", "source-entry-7eccdaff1ed7001a420165c1", "source-entry-0b82f1a2420993d2c460d0b3", "source-entry-6646b3e8e5b6c1c7204e4082", "source-entry-9c3b8ddd48c088f666c01ff7", "source-entry-1300443cc0df8ee26d260495", "source-entry-42fa2ae697ef6d04fda9644a", "source-entry-8a333f36d8520490edcb1d99", "source-entry-4c55c6a63f2e1c82c6ee0c92", "source-entry-3d77b81ab87109fefe9b3362", "source-entry-f656e98c282dd8b0b44d7771", "source-entry-66dcc338ae2c88784dde59eb", "source-entry-34b77e98043cd2e3cf96bb85", "source-entry-fd61900f8bd29c28a6049935", "source-entry-5132a31893d0019a8cb53359", "source-entry-64168d4279e7ece9dd5c3e9e"]
Return status=complete with one source_entry_id + ordered parts judgment for every listed entry, in manifest order, and no judgment for any other entry. Choose field IDs only from the packet field_id_vocabulary and preserve exact source text. Return semantic_judgments in the structured output. Each new judgment names source_entry_id from source_entries and an ordered parts array over that entry's exact text. When the entire entry has one semantic responsibility, explicitly declare one part with whole_entry=true, its role, and field_id when required. This assigns that responsibility to ALL source characters, including symbols and whitespace. Do not include text or whitespace transport on that part, and do not add other parts. For mixed responsibilities or required unit boundaries, submit text parts instead. A missing declaration never implies whole-entry responsibility. Preserve all whitespace; merely describing it in reason does not cover it. Boundary counts describe characters already present in the supplied text, not additional text. For an all-whitespace entry, leading and trailing counts refer to the same characters; do not add those counts to each other or to text_length. A source entry may report render_sensitive_codepoints with zero-based offsets, Unicode codepoints, and categories for characters that a font or renderer can hide or substitute. Preserve those exact characters in parts[].text; a JSON Unicode escape is equivalent to the literal character and is not a reason to request more input. When submitting text parts, for any part made only of whitespace, including one inside an entry that also has visible text, keep text empty and use one whitespace codepoint/count transport per codepoint run. For mixed whitespace, return consecutive transport parts in source order with the same role and field_id when their responsibility is the same. Harness expands each run only when it exactly matches the next source substring. A whitespace-only source entry is not an empty source entry; bare empty text without whitespace transport is valid only when source text length is zero. For a part containing visible text, keep text free of leading/trailing whitespace and encode those runs in leading_whitespace/trailing_whitespace arrays on that SAME part. Each array lists codepoint/count runs in source order. Preserve interior whitespace literally. These runs share the part's role and field_id; do not split one fill_slot into several parts merely to transport its edge whitespace. For example, a single part containing " Example" is represented as {"text":"Example","leading_whitespace":[{"codepoint":"U+0020","count":1}],"role":<your chosen role>} with field_id when that role requires it. Visible text and leading_whitespace/trailing_whitespace ARE allowed together; only the separate whitespace property requires empty text. Never substitute a role name or textual placeholder for whitespace. If the readable school evidence is insufficient, return status=needs_input and stop; do not invent an answer. This is a candidate only: Harness accepts the complete aggregated semantic set atomically after every batch is present. Do not materialize, render, publish, delegate, ask the user, or manage batch state.
